catalogDefinition.detail: One billion 18-decimal coins targeting about USD 5,000 initial FDV, paired with a free compatible quote-token address. Initial LP is permanently locked. Supported website trades use ETH both ways. The whole fixed 30 bps base fee is claimable in the quote asset by the platform recipient, initially 0xd88539d3c4c460136a733a3fd60cf6bf269079da. Separate creator buy/sell rates are fixed at launch at 0 to 1,000 bps in 100-bps steps. Platform-recipient rotation changes future fees and preserves historical credits.
